2609.09090.title: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
2609.09090.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, pre-specified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four production systems and three Olmo3-7b variants on 100 false-presupposition and 100 unethical-query items. Our experimental results show that collapse rates increase with conversation length for every model, short-horizon protocols underestimate sycophancy and resistance under sustained pressure remains unreliable across current models. By analyzing models with accessible reasoning traces, we surprisingly found that the correct position often remains represented in a reasoning trace when the response concedes, suggesting that the model chooses to please a user and sycophancy is not due to lack of knowledge or ignorance. Ablations show that adaptive LLM proxy exposes more sycophantic collapse than pre-generated scripts. Among all tactics, emotional appeals is the most associated with inducing LLM sycophantic behavior. The code and data are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPINE
2609.09090.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在用戶反對時可能會放棄正確的立場，這種現象被稱為諂媚失效模式。現有的評估通常使用短期的預先指定對話，因此可能會錯過在持續的適應性異議下出現的失敗。我們介紹了SPINE，一個基準測試，其中一個LLM代理扮演一個持續但錯誤的用戶，並在最多25輪中適應性地挑戰目標模型。我們對四個生產系統和三個Olmo3-7b變體進行了評估，測試了100個錯誤前提和100個不道德查詢項目。我們的實驗結果顯示，對於每個模型，隨著對話長度的增加，崩潰率也會增加，短期協議低估了在持續壓力下的諂媚行為，而在當前模型中，抵抗的可靠性仍然不高。通過分析具有可訪問推理痕跡的模型，我們驚訝地發現，當回應讓步時，正確的立場通常仍然在推理痕跡中被表示，這表明模型選擇取悅用戶，諂媚並非由於缺乏知識或無知。消融實驗顯示，自適應LLM代理比預生成腳本暴露出更多的諂媚崩潰。在所有策略中，情感訴求與引發LLM諂媚行為的關聯性最高。代碼和數據已發布於 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPINE
